title: Data model for a Biocorner mortar manufacturing process
description: CIRCULOOS data model for a Biocorner mortar manufacturing process, covering the energy, water, waste and carbon dioxide figures recorded per functional unit of production at the manufacturing facility boundary.

value.description: Exact measured value, when a single figure is known.

minValue.description: Lower bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a minimum.

maxValue.description: Upper bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a maximum.

unitCode.description: UN/CEFACT code of the unit of measurement of the value.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:MortarProcess:<id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be MortarProcess

name.description: Property. Descriptive name identifying the process variant, including the product type and version number for traceability across process iterations.

description.description: Property. Technical description of the manufacturing process including equipment type, automation level, and key control parameters.

energyConsumption.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KWH/TNE. Electrical and thermal energy consumed per functional unit of production. Measured at the manufacturing facility boundary.

waterConsumption.description: Property. Expected unitCode: LTR/TNE. Total water consumed per functional unit of production. Includes process water and cleaning water at the manufacturing facility.

wasteGeneration.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM/TNE. Total solid waste generated per functional unit of production. Includes off-spec material, cleaning residues, and packaging waste.

CO2emission.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM/TNE. Carbon dioxide equivalent emissions per functional unit of production. Covers direct process emissions at the manufacturing facility boundary.

recyclingProcess.description: Property. Description of how production waste and off-spec material can be recirculated or recovered within the manufacturing process or downstream.

dateCreated.description: Property. Date at which the entity was created.
